mapper.sql: over_time_requests . id AS id, employees.id AS employeeId, employees.name AS employeeNameEn, employees.name_kh AS employeeNameKh, over_time_requests.date_time_from AS dateForm, over_time_requests.date_time_to AS dateTo, over_time_requests.duration AS duration, over_time_requests.reason AS reason, over_time_requests.status AS status, over_time_requests.created AS created, over_time_requests.modified AS modified, CONCAT(IFNULL(user1.first_name,''), ' ', IFNULL(user1.last_name,'')) AS createdBy, CONCAT(IFNULL(user2.first_name,''), ' ', IFNULL(user2.last_name,'')) AS modifiedBy

FROM over_time_requests LEFT JOIN employees ON over_time_requests.employee_id = employees.id LEFT JOIN users AS user1 ON over_time_requests.created_by = user1.id LEFT JOIN users AS user2 ON over_time_requests.modified_by = user2.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO over_time_requests ( employee_id, date_time_from, date_time_to, duration, reason, status, created, created_by, is_active, modified, modified_by ) VALUES ( #{otRequest.employeeId}, #{otRequest.dateForm}, #{otRequest.dateTo}, #{otRequest.duration}, #{otRequest.reason}, 1, NOW(), #{otRequest.createdBy}, 1, NOW() NULL, #{otRequest.modifiedBy} )
